title: Expose answered board decisions to a headless agent
name: decision-catalog
description: Implement answered-decision catalog and search through core and MCP board records, with question, chosen option, rationale, later cost and binding provenance. A headless run already receives its bound answers through packages/core/src/brief.ts; let it look up other relevant answered decisions when needed. If no answer exists, distinguish a node-local implementation detail (continue) from a new choice that changes multiple nodes (pause and ask the human to open/answer a decision). Add focused core/MCP and integration tests.

brief.approach: Add a core helper that filters answered board decisions and searches their question, chosen option, rationale, later cost, and the binding nodes that supplied provenance. Expose it as one MCP tool in packages/mcp/src/tools/plan.ts, with concise tool guidance for a headless agent to search when a decision affects more than its own node and to pause when a cross-node choice has no answer. Reuse the existing board records and render conventions; do not add a separate catalog store. Cover result fields and matching in core tests, and tool registration/results in the MCP integration test.

acceptance.proves: Core tests confirm answered-decision search returns the question, selected option, rationale, costs, and node provenance, while excluding unanswered decisions.
The MCP integration test confirms a headless client can search and read matching answered decisions through the registered tool.
